description: This file declares interfaces for a message dispatcher system, including the IMessageDispatcher and IMessageDispatcherClient classes, with a focus on creating message dispatcher clients that interact with media keys.

classes.name: IMessageDispatcherClient
classes.description: Interface for message dispatcher clients, providing a virtual destructor.

classes.name: IMessageDispatcher
classes.description: Interface for message dispatchers, providing a method to create dispatcher clients.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an IMessageDispatcherClient, given a pointer to an IMediaKeysClient.
